parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
OK, let’s get started. Now, as you all know, we’ll be moving into our new office building next month, and I need to give you some information about the move.

When our graphic design company was established, with just the two of us ten years ago, this space was ideal, and the rent is very reasonable. But we’ve just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year; so we’ve decided to cut short our lease. I’m sure you’re going to like the new office.

We thought long and hard about the location, and we’ll be relocating to the industrial estate, which is also where all our materials are printed. That will mean we can save on transport costs, and we should be able to pass these savings on to our customers. That way we can keep our prices competitive as well.

Now, it’s important that you’re all aware of your responsibilities so that the move goes smoothly. We don’t require you to pack your things yourself. The movers will take care of all of that. I know some of you are wondering what we’re going to do about all the office furniture. The new office will be completely fitted out, so we don’t need any of this. What we’ve decided to do is offer it all for sale at very reasonable prices. So if you or anyone on the staff knows someone who wants a chair or filing cabinet, please let them know.

Those of you who previously stored files in your own offices are going to be sharing an open plan office. So this is going to require some adjustments in how we work. Over the next few weeks, I’d like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork. There’s no need to keep copies of anything. Remember things you’re currently working on should stay in the office due to our privacy laws.

Now, the day of the move itself will be a Saturday when we are closed for business. Thank you to those who have offered to come in on that day to assist, but we’d rather you didn’t. We’ll leave it all to the professionals. So just go directly to the new building on the Monday, and by then, hopefully all the hard work will have been done.

Now, if you take a look at the plan, I’ll show you the layout of our new office. Can you all see the lifts at the bottom of the plan? Now, as you come out of the lifts, you’ll see the reception is on the other side of the corridor. As you can see, it’s quite a large space, so there will be ample room for the receptionist’s desk straight in front of you, a waiting area for our clients on the left, and a display area over to the right.

Now, to reach your desk, you’ll need to walk through the reception to the open plan area at the back of the office suite. You’ll see some desks there drawn on the plan. For the sales staff, we’ve asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We’re aware that you’re on the phone a lot, talking to clients, and you’ll need some privacy. So that’s your area in the top left corner. Now, if you look at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway, you’ll see the designers’ desks. We didn’t want to put you too close to the entrance. Those desks to the right of the entrance to the open plan area will be for temporary staff.

Okay, let’s see now. What else do I need to point out? Oh yes, now I know some of you are concerned about noise problems in the open plan area, so I want to reassure you that we have made allowances for that, and there will be a conference room that you can reserve for meetings. That’s it just behind reception on the right, and we’re also going to have our own lunchroom, which is a big improvement on our current facilities. It’s outside the office, and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right. So no more eating at your desks, which is great news. Now, are there any questions or comments?

questions.question: What is the reason for the move?

analyses.content: 原文提到因为去年新招了6名员工，公司规模扩大，现有的空间不够用了（outgrown the space）。
Speaker: But we’ve just outgrown the space since we took on six new staff last year; so we’ve decided to cut short our lease.
A 选项（租约结束）是干扰项，原文说的是 "decided to cut short our lease"（提前终止租约）；B 选项（租金增加）未提及，原文反说现在的租金 "very reasonable"。

questions.question: The new office building is located close to the company’s

analyses.content: Speaker: ...we’ll be relocating to the industrial estate, which is also where all our materials are printed.
"Where all our materials are printed" 对应选项 A "printers"。
新办公室搬到了工业区，那里也是所有材料**印刷（printed）**的地方。

questions.question: The current office furniture will be

analyses.content: Speaker: What we’ve decided to do is offer it all for sale at very reasonable prices.
原文明确说是 "for sale"（出售），排除 C（赠送）；同时说 "we don't need any of this"（不需要这些），排除 A（搬运过去）。虽然原文主要对员工说，但 "anyone... knows someone" 暗示了对外销售的性质。
因为新办公室有全套家具，旧家具将被出售（offer it all for sale），员工或其熟人可以购买。

questions.question: What does the speaker tell the staff to do in the next few weeks?

analyses.content: Speaker: Over the next few weeks, I’d like you to go through your files and get rid of outdated and unnecessary paperwork.
"Get rid of outdated... paperwork" 对应选项 A "throw out old files"。原文说 "No need to keep copies"，排除 B；说 "should stay in the office"，排除 C（带回家）。
经理要求员工在接下来的几周里清理文件，**扔掉（get rid of）**过时和不必要的文书。

questions.question: On the day of the move, workers should

analyses.content: Speaker: Thank you to those who have offered to come in on that day to assist, but we’d rather you didn’t.
原文说 "we'd rather you didn't [come in]"，并指示大家周一直接去新大楼，意味着周六不用来帮忙。
搬家当天是周六，经理希望员工不要来（rather you didn't），把工作留给专业搬家公司，所以员工应该待在家里。
进入接待区后，接待桌正前方，客户等候区在左边，而展示区（display area）在右边（right）。
Speaker: ...a waiting area for our clients on the left, and a display area over to the right.
地图下方是入口，进门后 Reception desk 在中间。Desk 的右侧区域就是 B。
销售人员的区域在左上角（top left corner），并且有隔断与其他人分开。
"Top left corner" 是最关键的定位词，地图中开放办公区（Open Plan Area）的左上角就是 F。

For the sales staff, we've asked the builders to put in a partition between your area and the rest of the staff. We're aware that you're on the phone a lot talking to clients, and you'll need some privacy. So that's your area in the top left corner.
Speaker: Now, if you look at the very top of the plan, opposite the doorway, you’ll see the designers’ desks.
"Very top" 和 "opposite the doorway" 指向地图最上方中间的位置 G。
设计师的桌子在平面图的最顶端（very top），正对着门口（opposite the doorway）。
Speaker: That’s it just behind reception on the right.
"Behind reception on the right"。Reception 在下方中间，它的后面（上方）且靠右的房间是 A。
会议室就在接待处（reception）后面的右侧（on the right）。
Speaker: It’s outside the office, and you can see it at the bottom of your plan on the right.
"Outside the office" 意味着在走廊（Corridor）的另一侧，"Bottom... right" 锁定右下角的房间 C。
午餐室在办公室外面（outside the office），位于平面图的右下角（bottom... on the right）。
